text: I dont know, i have always been sick and constant pain for over 16years, i built my life around being one wrong sneeze away from death every second,  its been like three to four months since i finally manage to self heal, my life was constant improvement spiritual pursuit en improvement, en now i dont know because i can sense i can probably survive tsunami head on en thats the problem, sure i have long sesnsed like year close now that my life seemed to no longer be weaker threatening to collapse anytime but became boundless, that troubled me but i had pain to keep me company as usual so the was still possibilities that i was sensing wrong so i kept considering but now with better body that keep getting more aligned with spirit self im troubled because i really have no purpose beside spirituality hence anything thats improve beside that tend to results in me having to question my foundation but know my foundation is not the problem, if anything there is no problem i could fix by chnaging or destroying something, so im here wondering what the jollocks and gollocks is this.
